answer: The copper receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a velvet seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 72 aliases trips the duplicate check at the cipher gate. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
